name: a table that was laid with great care
description: A table, laid. Every object on it is in the only place it could be, and someone meant all of it.
looks: The fold in the cloth has been like that since before the table.
The salt is the whole of the argument, settled.
You could follow the grain out of the room, if you were braver.
says: Sit. It has been ready a long time.
It is not a shrine. It is only that everything is where it should be.
